ios.desc:
Take control of your clipboard and get more done! Pastey is your exclusive clipboard assistant that supports fast storage, management, and access of text and image snippets to make your work more efficient! Try it out and see the difference it makes in your workflow!

Pastey is an efficient clipboard management tool designed to increase your productivity. It'll store, manage, edit, and give you quick access to text and image clips. With its simple interface and a bunch of useful features, Pastey is like your right-hand man!

Key Features:
• Tagging: Just tag important clips with one click to find them easily.
• Customizable Hotkeys: Set up shortcuts to quickly launch Pastey and save time.
• Smart Island Support: Pastey can be pasted into the clipboard by clicking on Smart Island, which makes things easier for you.
• Auto-cleaning function: It regularly cleans out useless clipboard records to keep your data neat and tidy.
• Image export function: Quickly export images from the clipboard for easy use in other places.
• Data Import and Export: You can easily import and export clipboard data, and it works across different platforms.
• Desktop Hover Mode: You can quickly copy clipboard contents, avoid switching applications often, and improve operational efficiency.
• Quick access to the status bar: You can quickly view and use the clipboard content through the status bar, so you don't have to open other apps.
• Customized Mobile Keyboard: It'll help you manage your clipboard better on your phone and make it easier to access your content.
• Editable clipboard content: You can easily modify text and images stored on the clipboard to keep information up-to-date.

Additional features:
• Intelligent search: It's a simple and easy way to find what's on your clipboard.
• iCloud Synchronization: Synchronization across all devices keeps your clipboard content consistent.
• Dynamic interface design: the interface updates in real time based on what the user is doing.
• Multi-functional clipboard support: You can manage text and image clips, and find the info you need quickly.
• Simple Configuration Options: Minimal setup, fastest startup, easy customization of features.

Usage Scenarios:
• Office environment: in a busy workplace, you often need to copy text and images from multiple sources.Pastey helps you manage all clipboard content, avoid duplicate copying, and quickly access clipboard data in desktop hover mode.
